steps.activity: Procurement evaluates suppliers: ISO 14001, sustainable sourcing, carbon disclosure, waste reduction, ethical labor; assigns sustainability score alongside quality/price/delivery

steps.activity: Pricing Analyst reviews pricing: green products carry 5–15% premium; validates premium vs. certification cost and customer value (energy savings); checks competitiveness
Category Manager monitors sell-through: conversion (green vs. conventional), price sensitivity, margin vs. category average; adjusts to drive adoption while maintaining margin (30–35%)
Finance tracks green revenue: sales as % of total (target: 5–8% within 3 years), margin contribution, customer segment analysis; reports quarterly to CFO
